study_identification_part.si_4_title: Multivariate brain- cognition associations in euthymic bipolar disorder

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Normative model uses HCP Young Adult, OpenBHB, OASIS-3, Cam-CAN, and a Newcastle University single-site cohort (NCL); BLISS provides the BD/HC study cohort.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "We utilised four public datasets of T1-weighted scans from healthy controls: - the WU-Minn Human Connectome Project Young Adult (HCP; ...); - Open Big Healthy Brains (OpenBHB; ...); - Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (OASIS-3; ...); and - the Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (Cam-CAN; ...)." "We also used a cohort of healthy adult participants scanned at Newcastle University as part of another study (site=NCL)." "Data were collected as part of the Bipolar Lithium Imaging and Spectroscopy Study (BLISS)."
